product.name: Inmate Phone Calls
product.description: A service that provides low-cost phone call access to inmates in federal, state, and county correctional facilities.

product.name: Send Pictures to Inmates
product.description: A service allowing users to send printed photos directly from their devices to inmates in correctional facilities with included shipping.

product.name: Send Letters to Inmates
product.description: A digital letter sending service that allows users to compose and send letters to inmates, adhering to facility guidelines and restrictions.

identifier.value: Send Postcards and Greeting Cards to Inmates

product.name: Send Postcards and Greeting Cards to Inmates
product.description: A service that allows sending postcards and greeting cards for various occasions to inmates through digital ordering and physical delivery.

product.name: Inmate Locator Tool
product.description: An online tool to search and locate inmates in over 4,000 correctional facilities nationwide.
